summary: Initialized active v2 Bootstrap Planning Ledger for exact placeholder feature token `<feature name>`, registered it in ledger_registry.json, captured the collaborator planning persona and ledger-only constraints, and opened q-0001 to ask what we are working on before accepting product requirements.

Jared clarified the ledger covers `a bunch of miscellaneous things`; the first item is seeing historical documents made by PM wizards, meaning Plans and PRD docs created by the wizard, plus historical Orchestrator runs. GUI design is required and likely belongs on the Orchestrator page.

Jared accepted default final/approved document output visibility with user expansion to show everything, accepted all proposed historical run actions, and confirmed the existing Orchestrator History tab as the GUI home.

Jared accepted current-project lock for Orchestrator History, accepted final/approved output retention forever by default with retention/archive handling for expanded draft/intermediate history, and accepted document-specific row actions.
Jared accepted dense default History rows, accepted the Approved only vs All history per-project control, and required deep document comparison in MVP rather than deferring deeper comparison.

Jared answered `all of thodse`, accepting all proposed History export granularities for MVP: selected-row export, multi-select bundle export, and whole filtered-view export with an identity-preserving manifest.
Jared accepted all proposed export formats/profiles, accepted a combined deep comparison UI, and specified that archived records appear only after an extra Include archived control.

Jared said `yes`, accepting the recommended project-scoped unified History index/projection as the source-of-truth shape for the History surface instead of direct ad hoc subsystem queries at view time.

Jared said `yes`, accepting rebuildable unified History projection lifecycle semantics: rebuild from immutable source records, update from wizard/run/artifact/evidence/archive/lineage/manifest events, and detect/surface stale or out-of-sync state.

Jared said `sounds good`, accepting degraded-mode behavior for stale/out-of-sync History projections: read-only viewing with visible warning, a Rebuild action, and compare/export/reopen/send-forward blocked until rebuild succeeds.

Jared said `yes`, requesting a pre-compile pressure-test pass. The pass found five remaining underspecified surfaces for the first History item and proposed MVP defaults for row schema, permissions/redaction export profiles, search/filter syntax, empty states, and acceptance tests.

Jared said `yes`, accepting the pressure-test MVP defaults bundle for exact row schema fields, permissions/redaction export profiles, structured filter-chip search, explicit empty/degraded states, and acceptance-test coverage.
Jared said `next item`, choosing to continue the miscellaneous-feature ledger to the next item rather than pause or compile the accepted History item to canonical Plans.

Jared described the next miscellaneous item: `Could we adopt something like this` `https://github.com/alfaoz/opencode-see-image` for `models models without vision`, asked to pull the repo and see how it works, and noted PM would need to adapt it because `that is for Opencode`. The repo was inspected in `/tmp/pm-ext-opencode-see-image` at commit `cde1615f6dfc9039c58da6813112ee53391b5b49`.
